ballot.alt: Share card: what the Niagara County ballot of Tuesday, November 3, 2026 would cost a home - the North Tonawanda community center bond at $84 a year and the Somerset firefighter award program at $54 a year per $100,000 of assessed value, from the sponsors' own figures.
ballot.note: From the county's official sample ballots
stamp: No side taken: the sponsors' own figures, checked
ballot.sub: Every question on the county ballot, word for word, and what each costs a year per $100,000 of assessed value, from the sponsor's own figures.
ballot.title: What the ballot would cost a home
